title: Cross-asset divergence without a presumed sign
claim: Point-in-time basket divergence may predict continuation, reversal, or neither in a fresh frozen evaluation.
mechanism: Temporary or informational common-factor departures are observationally distinct only after conditional testing.
target: Outright and training-only factor-residual log returns within a dynamic basket.
horizon: Locked campaign horizon grid; sign and one horizon selected only in development.
informationSet: Point-in-time basket membership, prior returns, and training-only factor estimates

evidence.summary: Basket-4 development produced a positive selected specification and a clean registered placebo, but basket-6 work stopped in breadth, basket 10 was untested, and the historical membership limitation still prohibits confirmation.

nextAction: Resolve point-in-time delisting and membership provenance before proposing fresh evidence. Do not use the opened V2 development period as confirmation.
